quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x25000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What are you looking at?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There are notes about taking care of flowers in this notebook.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Paimon wants to see...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "... Should be placed in open space, and receive plenty of sunshine..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess Collei didn't have the time to move it outside.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, let's take care of it for Collei then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Anyway, we should move the flower first. Let's put it beside the house.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't put it too far away, or Collei will be worried if she can't find it when she's back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, this letter seems to be written by Collei. Let's check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But why isn't she here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Might be out working with Tighnari again. They have always been really busy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come on, read the letter. Just looking at this writing, Paimon bets Collei pressed down her pen really hard on the letter...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #"{NICKNAME} and Paimon, thanks for caring for my flower."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "We have so many things to deal with in the forest, and it's easy to forget about things when we get busy..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Thanks again for your help. Let's eat some Potato Boats at Mr. Jahangir's place when I have some free time!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Collei is gonna give us a treat! Paimon will write this down and remember it by heart.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Paimon still has no idea what Collei is working on. She seems to have her hands full.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon hopes she's still getting enough sleep...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, Paimon will leave this flower here to grow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Let's leave Collei a letter and tell her that we moved the flower out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Otherwise, she might think someone broke into her house.
